picker.title: Feature blocks
picker.segment_rows_placeholder: Menu rows will appear here once you switch on at least one block.
picker.disable_confirm: Do you want to switch off "{{block}}"? Its menu rows stay in place and are only hidden, your data stays unchanged. You can switch the block back on at any time.
picker.profile_highlight_note: The highlighted blocks belong to this profile. Nothing is switched on yet — do that for each highlighted block yourself with "Enable".
picker.details_no_menu: This block does not bring any menu rows of its own.
picker.enable_dependency_reason_fallback: switched on together with the block you chose
picker.rows_other_drift: These fields also differ from the catalogue
picker.rows_pinned_note: This field is pinned — the catalogue no longer writes it
picker.rows_adjust_catalogue_toast: Note copied — pass it on to the development team so the catalogue gets adjusted
picker.rows_nothing_planned: There is nothing to apply — the value is already up to date or pinned
picker.compare_fork_note: This is your own copy. The shared original belongs to other tenants and cannot be shown here.
picker.help_blocks_vs_rows: A block is a group of menu rows that together make up one feature — for example "Calendar" or "Chat". A menu row is a single entry in your club's menu, with an address, a role it needs, and a few other fields. The "Blocks" tab switches whole features on or off, the "Menu rows" tab shows you every single row and where its value differs from the catalogue.
picker.help_actions: Apply writes the catalogue value into your menu. Pin keeps your value and tells the catalogue to leave it alone from now on. Adjust catalogue writes nothing — it sends a note to the development team because your value would also be right for the other clubs. The question that helps you choose between the two: should this value also apply to the other clubs? Yes → Adjust catalogue. No → Pin.
picker.help_pinned: A pinned field is yours. The catalogue no longer suggests a value for it and will not write it in future updates either. You can undo the pin at any time with "Unpin".
picker.help_promise: This page deletes nothing and never changes an existing row without your consent.
picker.enable_dialog_intro: Here you choose which menu rows are created. Anything you leave unticked is simply not created — nothing is lost, and you can add it later at any time from the menu rows list.
